Recognize the approach

Digital brutalism often foregrounds raw structure and utilitarian presentation.

Look for

  • Exposed structure and blunt type
  • Obvious links
  • Limited decorative polish

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Digital brutalism often foregrounds raw structure and utilitarian presentation. It can reference architectural ideas, but it is not a direct translation of concrete buildings into CSS.

Period or influence

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Start with semantic HTML and intentionally simple CSS.
  2. Retain reading order and meaningful links. Distinguish purposeful restraint from a broken or inaccessible interface.

Small practice task

Present a project directory with no images or decorative containers. Make the link hierarchy unmistakable.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
